title: 00538 - P150A/005386
commonCauses: Fault Code stored in Gösterge Paneli
If the battery was disconnected, the dash panel reset, resulting in the inability to transmit a time signal.
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  Gösterge Paneli for Fault Codes
Clear fault codes, start engine (idle for 30 seconds), switch ignition off, switch ignition on, Kontrol edin: and clear codes if needed
technicalNotes:
Bu arıza kodu şu modülde görüldüğünde: VW Tiguan (5N): 2.0TFSI (CCTA), see TSB 01-08-20/TPI 2018467 for Details.
Update ECU Software
